title: Snapshot retry-backoff assertion should reject a no-backoff timestamp independently of scheduling delay
outcome: The older_turn_in_retry fixture in src/tests/engram_source_root_selection_snapshot.rs proves a retry backoff was applied with a check that a no-backoff regression cannot pass, whatever the host load.
acceptance: A regression that writes retry_at = now (no backoff) on the first failed closing-result install fails the fixture even when the test thread is descheduled for over a second between recording the reference time and the install writing retry_at.
The fixture still passes deterministically under concurrent test load: no assertion compares retry_at with a wall-clock reading taken after the install.
No new diagnostics or logging are added; the change is limited to test code or a test-only seam.
